concept: Trailer 3D dynamique façon reveal manette PlayStation — 3 actes noir/rose/gris, snap zooms, produit décentré

product.title: Masque de someil Bluetooth 3D — Dors Mieux Dès Ce Soir

params.prompt: High-energy cinematic 3D product trailer in the exact style of an official PlayStation DualSense controller reveal: the product flies and banks through dark space like a spaceship, rising while rotating, dynamic editing with sudden snap zooms and off-center compositions — the product is NOT always centered in frame. The hero product is the sleep mask from the reference images: a 3D contoured memory-foam Bluetooth sleep mask with a small control pad with three glowing blue buttons; the back/inner side has a removable contoured inner cushion exactly as shown in the back-view reference images. Stay perfectly faithful to the references. Environment: infinite pitch-black studio, subtle reflective floor far below, volumetric haze, deep blue and violet rim lights, tiny luminous particles, discreet gold accents — nighttime Nocturna brand palette. Structure in three acts of roughly equal length with fast whip cuts between them: ACT 1 (0-3.5s) the BLACK mask ascends from darkness like a spacecraft, banking and rotating to show front, profile and inner cushion, one sudden snap zoom onto the glowing button pad, framed off-center. ACT 2 (3.5-6.5s) flash cut — the PINK variant of the same mask, different angle, spinning and rising through light streaks, quick snap zoom, dynamic diagonal composition. ACT 3 (6.5-10s) flash cut — the GREY variant sweeps in rotating, then a final hero beat: the black mask returns fully lit in slow motion, and a clean end card on black background with elegant glowing text: 'NOCTURNA' with tagline 'Dors mieux dès ce soir' and the promo line '-20%' with the code 'NOCTURNA20' — the code must be spelled EXACTLY 'NOCTURNA20', one word, uppercase, no spaces, no extra characters. Premium cinematic quality, fluid motion, high contrast, shallow depth of field, epic trailer sound design: rising whooshes on each cut and a deep bass impact on the final reveal.
